description: Screenshot of the celestial-pelle rift bar with a milestone hover tooltip open (870x142 px). The circled tooltip reads '40% (6.55e2362 IP)' on its first line and 'caAuIm ... also affects EP gain' on its second. 'caAuIm' is a mid-transition scramble of 'Vacuum' produced by wordShift.wordCycle() over the first rift's name list ['Vacuum', 'Hollow', 'Void'] - the same cycling that renders 'Hollow' in the two panel headers either side of the bar in this frame. The tooltip is carrying its pink 'reached' treatment here, which comes from a computed reading the milestone's canBeApplied prototype getter. Both tooltip lines are produced by template method calls inside a stable scoped slot, and none of the three sources - the cycling name, the fill readout, the unlock getter - is a tracked reactive dependency, so the slot is never re-rendered and that computed's cache is never invalidated: the tooltip freezes whole at its first-rendered state. The defect is that neither text line nor the highlight updates for as long as the tooltip stays open.
